title: Prompt Engineering in Segment Anything Model: Methodologies, Applications, and Emerging Challenges
abstract: arXiv:2507.09562v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The Segment Anything Model (SAM) has transformed image segmentation by introducing a prompt-based paradigm that enables strong zero-shot generalization. In this framework, prompts serve as a semantic interface between human intent and machine perception, making prompt engineering a central factor in model performance. Despite its importance, prompt engineering within SAM and its variants has not yet been systematically reviewed in the literature. This survey addresses that gap by providing a structured and comprehensive overview of prompt engineering techniques developed for SAM and its rapidly growing ecosystem. We introduce a hierarchical taxonomy that organizes methods into geometric prompts, textual semantic prompts, and multimodal fusion prompts, and analyze how these categories reflect different design principles and application goals. translated_title: 在分割一切模型中的提示工程：方法、应用与新兴挑战
translated_abstract: arXiv:2507.09562v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：分割一切模型（SAM）通过引入基于提示的范式，实现了强大的零样本泛化能力，从而变革了图像分割领域。在此框架中，提示充当人类意图与机器感知之间的语义接口，使提示工程成为模型性能的核心因素。尽管其重要性不言而喻，但SAM及其变体中的提示工程尚未在文献中得到系统性综述。本综述通过提供针对SAM及其快速扩展生态系统所开发的提示工程技术的结构化全面概述，填补了这一空白。我们引入了一个分层分类体系，将方法组织为几何提示、文本语义提示和多模态融合提示，并分析了这些类别如何反映不同的设计原则和应用目标。此外，我们探讨了从手工设计的提示向更先进、更自动化提示的转变过程。
tldr: 本综述首次系统性地梳理了分割一切模型（SAM）中的提示工程技术，提出了涵盖几何、文本语义和多模态融合的分层分类体系，并分析了从手工提示向高级自动化提示的演进趋势。
en_tdlr: This survey provides the first systematic review of prompt engineering techniques in the Segment Anything Model (SAM), proposing a hierarchical taxonomy covering geometric, textual semantic, and multimodal fusion prompts, while analyzing the evolution from manual to advanced automated prompts.
